# ClassLink | Identity & Access Management for Education
> ClassLink is a provider of identity and access management products offering instant access to apps and files with SSO, class rostering, account provisioning, and analytics.

## Sitemap
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.classlink.com/sitemap.xml)

## ClassLink
- [Home](https://www.classlink.com/): ClassLink is a provider of identity and access management products offering instant access to apps and files with SSO, class rostering, account provisioning, and analytics.
- [Request Demo](https://www.classlink.com/request-demo): Discover the ClassLink difference! Learn how ClassLink helps everyone in the school system, from students to leaders and all those in between. Sign up for a demo today.
- [Login to ClassLink LaunchPad](https://launchpad.classlink.com/)

## Solutions
- [Solutions Library](https://www.classlink.com/solutions)

- [ClassLink Enterprise](https://www.classlink.com/enterprise): Enterprise identity and access management for education. PAM, SCIM, SIEM, a dedicated solutions team, and custom SLAs for 75,000+ user institutions.
- [CL for K-12](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/k-12-overview): Deliver on the promise of education technology! ClassLink takes SSO further with rostering, analytics, and multi-factor authentication—all at no extra cost.
- [CL for Higher Ed](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/higher-ed-overview): Transform digital access at your institution with ClassLink’s SSO platform, complete with MFA, analytics, self-serve password resets, and 24/7 support.
- [CL for States](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/statewide-overview): Ensure equitable digital learning access and safeguard Personally Identifiable Information (PII) for every learner with a statewide ClassLink adoption.
- [Identity & Access Management Identity & Access Management](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/identity-and-access-management): As the leading Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution for education, ClassLink streamlines account management, automates rostering, and keeps data safe.
- [Learning Analytics](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/learning-analytics): Education leaders need a full picture of app usage and edtech spending to make better decisions. Complete your institution’s data story with ClassLink’s analytics suite.
- [Cybersecurity for Education Cybersecurity for Education](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/cybersecurity-for-education): Discover ClassLink's cybersecurity hub; your go-to for resources on how we protect your data with advanced security features, tools, and best practices.
- [Transparency & Trust Transparency & Trust](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/transparency-and-trust): ClassLink is committed to keeping your private data secure. From our transparent policies to our real-time updates, we're open about how we keep you safe.
- [Multi-Factor Authentication Multi-Factor Authentication](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/multi-factor-authentication): Take your cybersecurity to the next level with ClassLink’s authentication methods, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), to keep student data safe.
- [Single Sign-On for Education Single Sign-On for Education](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/single-sign-on-for-education): With our ClassLink’s affordable and reliable single sign-on solutions, you can streamline access to all of your educational resources with just one login.
- [Remote Learning](https://www.classlink.com/solutions/remote-learning): ClassLink makes the switch to remote learning easier by creating consistency in how students and staff engage with digital learning tools, no matter where they are.

## Products
- [Product Library](https://www.classlink.com/products)

- [LaunchPad](https://www.classlink.com/products/launchpad): LaunchPad provides quick SSO access to a personalized portal of digital resources from anywhere while protecting sensitive data with secure Multi-Factor Authentication.
- [Analytics](https://www.classlink.com/products/analytics): Measure digital engagement and provide insight on everything from equitable access, to ROI and professional development needs with ClassLink Analytics.
- [Analytics+](https://www.classlink.com/products/analytics-plus): Complete your understanding of digital engagement for your school system! Analytics+ expands the usage analytics you see through ClassLink to include any digital resource.
- [OneSync](https://www.classlink.com/products/onesync): ClassLink OneSync automatically imports your SIS and human resources user lists into Microsoft Active Directory, Google Directory, and Office365 to easily create logins.
- [Roster Server](https://www.classlink.com/products/roster-server): ClassLink Roster Server reduces time spent on manual account rostering processes, securely and automatically delivering class rosters to your favorite digital resources.
- [DataGuard](https://www.classlink.com/products/dataguard): DataGuard is a Roster Server upgrade that empowers schools to take control of the data they share with vendors, minimizing security risks and keeping sensitive PII safe.
- [Audit Center](https://www.classlink.com/products/audit-center): Streamline projects and meet goals efficiently with ClassLink Audit Center—a centralized hub to organize, access, and share evidence for seamless collaboration.
- [StateLink](https://www.classlink.com/products/statelink): Build an equitable digital ecosystem for your state's schools! StateLink is your secure gateway to resources, linking every student and educator to learning.
- [Security Center](https://www.classlink.com/products/security-center): ClassLink Security Center finds, tracks, and catalogs security events and suspicious activity, making it easier for you to take action and protect your data.
- [AppTrack](https://www.classlink.com/products/apptrack): ClassLink AppTrack simplifies software approvals with a structured workflow, ensuring security, interoperability, and budget oversight for schools.
- [ThreatScan](https://www.classlink.com/products/threatscan): ClassLink ThreatScan detects compromised school credentials on the dark web, alerts admins, and helps prevent cyber threats before they escalate.
- [OneData](https://www.classlink.com/products/onedata): ClassLink OneData automates the retrieval, merging, and secure transfer of student performance data, eliminating errors and delays so educators can focus on student success.
- [Insights](https://www.classlink.com/products/insights): Discover which edtech tools actually improve student performance. ClassLink Insights connects usage data to assessment scores, giving you evidence for smarter decisions.
- [My Classes](https://www.classlink.com/products/my-classes): From measuring student engagement and easily assigning apps to a customizable dashboard for each class, My Classes is the simpler way to support student success.
- [My Files](https://www.classlink.com/products/my-files): Solve the problem of too many files in too many places! ClassLink My Files gives students and faculty instant access to all their files, all in one location.
- [Public & Parent Portal](https://www.classlink.com/products/portals): Build connections with your learning community using ClassLink’s Public and Parent Portals. These portals keep families connected, informed, and involved in student success.
- [Login Options](https://www.classlink.com/products/login-options): Support learners of all abilities! ClassLink’s login options are designed to meet a variety of needs, making logging in quick and simple for everyone.
- [LaunchPad Customization](https://www.classlink.com/products/launchpad-customization): Fully customize your ClassLink login page and LaunchPad to reflect your institution’s brand, making them instantly recognizable to your learning community.

## Resources
- [Cybersecurity Funding](https://www.classlink.com/resources/cpp): ClassLink is a 100% eligible purchase for schools using SLCPP funding. Learn about eligibility, and find support for bidding and purchasing.
- [Case Studies](https://www.classlink.com/resources/case-studies): ClassLink empowers millions of students with instant access to digital resources. Discover why schools prefer ClassLink as their Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution.
- [Videos](https://www.classlink.com/resources/videos): Catch the ClassLink suite in action! See firsthand how ClassLink bridges the gap between learning and education technology, maximizing return on digital investments.
- [Webinars](https://www.classlink.com/resources/webinars): Ready to learn more about ClassLink? Sign up for a webinar with one of our expert instructors and explore what the full ClassLink suite has to offer today.
- [ClassLink Insiders Club](https://www.classlink.com/insiders-club): Join the ClassLink Insider’s Club for exclusive access, special recognition, and rewards as you connect and shape the future of ClassLink.
- [Back-to-School Readiness](https://www.classlink.com/resources/back-to-school-readiness): Preparing for back-to-school isn’t just a summer task — it’s a year-round team effort. Together, we can implement solutions and tackle back-to-school challenges head-on.
- [Back-to-School Checklist](https://www.classlink.com/resources/bts-checklist): Prepare your ClassLink platform for a successful start to the school year! With these lists, you’ll be ready for every stage of your back-to-school planning.
- [LinkedUp Podcasts](https://www.classlink.com/podcasts/linkedup): Tune in to LinkedUp: Breaking Boundaries in Education, to hear from Jerri Kemble and Jamie Saponaro as they seek global perspectives on educational topics that matter.
- [Perspectives Podcasts](https://www.classlink.com/podcasts/perspectives): Bringing together the perspectives of thought leaders, the Perspectives podcast serves as a forum to solve education-based interoperability issues and find common ground.
- [ClassLink Academy](https://www.classlink.com/academy): ClassLink Academy gives you quick, convenient training for your entire district, including admins, instructors, and students—all easily accessible from your LaunchPad.
- [SSO Library Search](https://www.classlink.com/resources/sso-search): Explore ClassLink's library of single sign-on apps! Choose from thousands of SSO apps available in ClassLink, or have us add custom apps free of charge.
- [CDN Check](https://www.classlink.com/resources/cdn): We're here to help! Use ClassLink's Content Delivery Network (CDN) Check page to verify that your network can access all required assets for ClassLink LaunchPad.

## Company
- [About Us](https://www.classlink.com/company/about): Since 1998, ClassLink has empowered educators to improve learning through innovative services. We remove barriers between students and resources to ensure learning thrives.
- [Awards](https://www.classlink.com/company/awards): ClassLink is a multi-award-winning identity and access management solution. From SIIA CODiEs to EdTech Digest Awards, ClassLink has been a winner for over 25 years.
- [Partners](https://www.classlink.com/company/partners): Interoperability shouldn't cost a dime! Learn how you can integrate with our single sign-on rostering platforms at no cost to support what matters most: learners.
- [Cybersecurity Rubric](https://www.cybersecurityrubric.org/): Joining forces to combat cybersecurity attacks on schools, the Cybersecurity Coalition for Education created the Cybersecurity Rubric (CR) for Education - an effective approach to improving cybersecurity readiness.
- [Secure by Design](https://www.classlink.com/company/secure-by-design): ClassLink is a proud signatory of the Secure by Design pledge. Developed by The White House, Department of Ed, and CISA, this pledge strengthens K–12 cybersecurity via edtech.
- [Careers](https://www.classlink.com/company/careers): Join the ClassLink team and transform the future of education! Together, we can support all learners by connecting them with the digital resources they need.
- [MPACT Program](https://www.classlink.com/company/mpact): The MPACT program provides professional development, networking opportunities, and full immersion into our company culture here at ClassLink. Apply Today!
- [Contact Us](https://www.classlink.com/contact): Need help or have a question? You’re in the right place. Schedule a demo or get in touch with a ClassLink support specialist. Our team of experts is happy to help!

## Help
- [Support](https://help.classlink.com/s/technical-support): Explore ClassLink's stellar around-the-clock support options.
- [Status](https://status.classlink.com/) - Welcome to ClassLink's home for real-time and historical data on system performance.
- [Security](https://www.classlink.com/company/security): ClassLink maintains a wide range of security controls to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your data. We're committed to keeping your data safe.
- [Privacy](https://www.classlink.com/company/privacy): Learn how ClassLink keeps your information secure and private. We're committed to ensuring that all PII is secure and the privacy of our customers and team is protected.
- [ClassLink Help Center](https://help.classlink.com/s/)

## Blog Posts
- [Blog](https://www.classlink.com/resources/blog): Learn from leaders like you! Hear from trusted education leaders and ClassLink experts. ClassLink's blog features expert advice, resources, and knowledge.

- [CLON26: Highlights, Big Announcements, and A Look At What’s Next] (https://www.classlink.com/blog/keeping-up-with-clon-mar-2026): CLON 2026 was our biggest gathering yet, bringing nearly 300 district IT leaders, edtech innovators, and ClassLink experts together to share ideas, tackle real challenges, and explore what’s next for digital learning. From packed sessions and hands-on workshops to in-depth conversations with peers who truly “get it,” this year’s conference was full of moments that reminded us why the ClassLink community is so special.
- [Why Higher Education Needs Passkeys Now](https://www.classlink.com/blog/why-higher-education-needs-passkeys-now): Higher education is facing a critical authentication challenge. As campuses expand digital access, security vulnerabilities have grown in tandem. Billions of breached credentials circulate online, and traditional authentication methods like passwords and conventional MFA struggle to keep pace with sophisticated phishing attacks and credential theft.
- [Make Data-Driven Decisions Without the Assessment Data Overwhelm] (https://www.classlink.com/blog/make-data-driven-decisions-without-the-assessment-data-overwhelm): Wrangling your assessment data together into something meaningful can be transformational for schools. But it can also make you want to pull your hair out. You know the feeling: you've got a dozen tabs open, you're combing through files with names like Final-Final-Version3.xlsx, and you have that creeping suspicion you’ve missed something important.

## News Posts
- [News](https://www.classlink.com/company/news): Read the latest ClassLink buzz! Explore our News page to discover the impact ClassLink has worldwide. From awards to product releases, ClassLink is making waves in edtech.

- [ClassLink Announces Insights and 24 New Capabilities at CLON26](https://www.classlink.com/news/classlink-announces-insights-and-24-new-capabilities-at-clon26): ClassLink announced over two dozen capabilities and one brand-new product at CLON 2026, the company's sixth annual conference. The announcements are organized around three themes: Access, Automation, and Analytics. The headline was ClassLink Insights, the first learning analytics platform to connect edtech usage with student assessment scores.
- [ClassLink Scores Triple Category Win for Tech & Learning’s Best of 2025 Awards](https://www.classlink.com/news/classlink-scores-triple-category-win-for-tech-and-learnings-best-of-2025-awards): Tech & Learning has named ClassLink a winner of its Awards of Excellence: Best of 2025, recognizing the full ClassLink Suite across all three education categories. This distinction highlights ClassLink’s ability to support learners, educators, and institutions at every stage of the educational journey.
- [From Early Adopter to Data Leadership: Delaware’s Education Data Journey](https://www.ed-fi.org/resources/case-studies/delaware/): Delaware began using the Ed-Fi Data Standard more than ten years ago. Early on, the Department of Education’s (DOE) technology team used it behind the state’s data warehouse to support educator dashboards. As the work evolved, the state started to see where data quality was breaking down.
- [AppTrack Recognized as a 2026 Top EdTech Product by District Administration and FETC](https://www.classlink.com/news/apptrack-recognized-as-a-2026-top-edtech-product-by-district-administration-and-fetc): ClassLink, a global leader in digital access and learning analytics, announced today that AppTrack has been named a 2026 Top EdTech Product by District Administration in partnership with the Future of Education Technology® Conference (FETC®).

## Events
- [CLON: ClassLink Conference](https://www.classlink.com/clon): CLON 2027 is ClassLink’s premier in-person learning and networking event for educators and education technology leaders, taking place March 2–4, 2027, in Jersey City, New Jersey.
- [CLAS: ClassLink Learning Analytics Conference](https://www.classlink.com/clas) : Attend the ClassLink Learning Analytics Summit and learn how analytics can help your team make more informed decisions around instruction, professional development, and more.
- [ClassLink CyberSession](https://www.classlink.com/cybersession): Join cybersecurity experts and leaders at the ClassLink CyberSession to gain cyber-secure insights and enhance your cybersecurity.
- [ClassLink Back to School Summit](https://www.classlink.com/bts-summit): ClassLink's Back to School Summit is a virtual event for education leaders to come together and improve the back-to-school season throughout the education industry.

## Social Channels
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/classlinkinc/)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/classlink)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/classlink_edu/)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/ClassLinkEdu)

How Can ClassLink Help?

Create an environment where education and technology work together so learning can flourish. From access and analytics to cybersecurity and identity management, ClassLink’s affordable and reliable solutions help you use technology in ways that promote and support learning. See why over 3,300 school systems love learning with ClassLink.

Identity & Access Management

Manage accounts and deliver rosters with greater security, accuracy, and speed than you ever thought possible—with ClassLink’s advanced Identity and Access Management (IAM) suite. Roster Server and OneSync work together to automate and simplify rostering and account provisioning. The result is everyone has secure, personalized access starting on day one.

Learn More

Learning Analytics

Complete your understanding of digital engagement for all students, instructors, and staff within your school system. Use analytics to better understand everything from equitable access and engagement to the return on your investments and staff professional development needs. ClassLink Analytics and Analytics+ present this data from the district level, down to the individual student, to help you make informed purchasing decisions and better support learning.

Learn More

Cybersecurity & MFA

Keep digital identities secure without complicating access to learning. ClassLink provides secure authentication options, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), that protect and verify accounts while still helping even your youngest students quickly access learning resources. Plus, our security protocols and privacy policy help keep your data private and protected.

Learn More

Secure Single Sign-On

Strengthen data security while you improve access to digital apps and resources with LaunchPad, a single sign-on (SSO) solution built for education. LaunchPad provides quick SSO access to a personalized portal of digital apps and resources while protecting sensitive data with secure Multi-Factor Authentication. Whether students are learning at school or remote, LaunchPad delivers secure access to all your digital resources across your institution.

Learn More

Transparency & Trust

Create family and community connections with ClassLink’s Portals. Use our Public Portal to help meet state legislation requirements and create transparency by sharing the third-party vendors approved for use in your schools. Then, help parents and families manage school life with quick access to frequently-used resources through our Parent Portal.

Learn More

What's New With ClassLink

Learn from leaders like you and stay up-to-date with the latest blog posts and news!

Mask Student Data From Vendors, Not From Teachers

ClassLink DataGuard now includes TrueView, which lets teachers see student names in apps where vendors only get masked data. How many companies hold the names of your students right now? Count the apps that receive your class rosters. Most of them store student names, email addresses, and ID numbers on servers your school system doesn't control. That data can stay there long after you stop sending it.

Read Blog Post


Analytics+ Brings Safari Activity Into View

Using Safari on school-managed Macs? You can now bring that resource usage into Analytics+, including resources accessed outside LaunchPad. Safari joins Chrome and Edge as a supported browser, giving you broader coverage across your school-issued devices.

Read Blog Post

ClassLink announces the availability of ClassLink Insights, a learning analytics product that helps school systems answer one of the toughest questions facing education: How does edtech usage relate to student outcomes?
